train32.scope: Training/quarantine data diagnostic only; no target edits, model prediction or held-out scoring.
train32.method: Measured same-color CFA residuals normalized by declared shot/read plus ADC variance; phase-centered lag correlation at2 sensor pixels, first-order gradient fit for a rough x/y translation descriptor.
train32.selection: Reference mask, target in(.005,.95), observed<.99, >=128 samples/phase. No rejection/admission threshold is applied.
train32.limitations: Reference noise is omitted from the normalization proxy. Real correlated sensor noise, gain/black-level errors, defocus, motion, interpolation and clipping can cause correlation or apparent shifts. Neither a nonzero fit nor correlation proves misregistration. Inspect native pairs; do not automatically change targets or evaluation.
